newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums hold, but futures tumble.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums hold, but futures tumble.

text.p: NWE gas oil slipped on Thursday as futures fell sharply, but steady premiums limited excessive falls.
April IPE gas oil expired at $160.25 with deliveries against the contract at 107,200 tonnes. May took over the baton but continued to stumble, last trading down $3.75 a tonne at $160.50.
Russian material was pegged between May IPE +$1.25-$2.00, supported by the absence of large cargoes which for the most part are heading eastwards.
FOD was still very much in the doldrums, but able to notionally command premiums of around May IPE +$4-5 cif NWE for first and second half while DIN was put a dollar or so below this.
Diesel retained early week strength with bids for April 20-30 heard at May IPE +$12, but no offers to match against it.
